effect.jabbadream.panic.desc: Cannot sleep, nor properly use functional blocks.
jabbadream.chat.status_in: §aYou are in the §6Dream-Real Superposition§a until the next sleep.
jabbadream.chat.status_out: §7You truly wake up from the dream — superposition lifted.
jabbadream.chat.backup_fail: §c[JABD] Backup failed, superposition NOT activated. Check server log.
jabbadream.chat.real_death: §4…You truly died. It truly was just a bad dream.
jabbadream.chat.rollback.death_self_sile: §4…You jolt awake from the nightmare. The world is returning to reality…
jabbadream.chat.rollback.broadcast_silen: §6[JABD] §9%s jolted awake… as if it was all just a dream.
jabbadream.chat.rollback.broadcast_hard: §6[JABD] §c%s has awoken from their worst nightmare… the world will now restart.
jabbadream.chat.rollback.wake_self: §a✨ You jolt awake… back from the nightmare.
jabbadream.chat.one_for_all.wake_broadca: §9%s had a nightmare… the world shudders, and you are pulled back from the edge of sleep too.
jabbadream.chat.wake_reality: §a✨ You jolt awake… back from the nightmare.
jabbadream.chat.panic_sleep: §cYou are in a panic and cannot sleep.
jabbadream.chat.panic_interact: §cYou are in a panic and cannot focus on using this.
jabbadream.chat.bed_uncharged: §cThis bed is uncharged and cannot be used. Right-click with a recharge item to restore it.
jabbadream.chat.bed_recharged: §aThe Warm Bed is recharged! You can sleep again.
jabbadream.tooltip.warm_bed.line3: §7Real death rollbacks the world, and you wake up in panic.
jabbadream.tooltip.warm_bed.line4: §5(While panicked you cannot sleep or use functional blocks.)
jabbadream.tooltip.warm_bed.line5: §7Single use — recharge with the crafting item after waking
